reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing exported getScheduledAmount and replaces every server-side midpoint copy (forecast, action sync, posting, preview, templates) with calls to it, letting it handle missing, single and ranged amounts.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the midpoint/dispatch ternary; the only remaining local branch is schedule-template's existing op check on its own condition.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module client and server already use for schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the rule, its call sites, tests and a release note change; widening the parameter type to accept null matches the helper's existing null guard.

maintainability.why: A future change to how a ranged amount is planned is a one-line edit in one function that every path uses.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server sites that resolved schedule amounts now call getScheduledAmount instead of their own ternaries.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are removed, not reshaped.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by forecast normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedule-template.ts and the client components.
